details.completeness_justification: The candidate summary adequately covers the core material meaning of K1-K8 and K10, representing revenue growth, EBIT performance, segment details, geographic performance, cash flow, dividend/share buyback, and product launches. However, K9 (Ambu Recircle Program extension to include collection/recycling of blades from SureSight, planned for 2026) and K11 (Sustainability milestones including operationalization of Ambu Recircle Program across four markets and production of first batch of recycled material from endoscopes) are entirely missing. These are important HIGH and MEDIUM items respectively, but their absence does not fundamentally alter the overall financial picture presented. Therefore, the coverage is generally good but not complete.

Segment performance (S4-S7) shows clear differentiation between business groups with specific growth drivers. Geographic performance (S8-S9) provides balanced perspectives on regional variations. Profitability metrics (S10-S13) show clear cause-and-effect relationships between margin contraction and external factors. Cash flow explanations (S15-S16) logically connect operating results to free cash flow changes. The forward guidance (S18) aligns with reported performance trends. There are no material repetitions, logical gaps, or organizational issues that would undermine the summary's internal coherence.
